verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only one-off scheduling: an email can be sent 'at a specific date and time.' It also shows event-triggered automation, such as RSS/blog emails sent on publish and simple workflows that run after an email is sent. Neither is a recurring time-based schedule for jobs or workflows, so this is adjacent, not direct, support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
